coaching.headline: Paper favored us in four of five lanes and we opened 6-1 across the first two fights — then Fangtooth went over three times, we cashed one won fight to their four, and the majors ledger closed 11-22.
coaching.team: This film is a clinic in one-sided trades. At 10 Murdock won the bodies 2-0 at their Fangtooth pit while they took Fangtooth itself across the map, and the 16.6 won teamfight was traded the same way. Our losses were downhill fights: 12.7 went 0-3 with Mini Prime following at 13.7, and 19.7 and 23.8 both went 0-2 with the same macro note each time — the duo lane was ahead and in lane, not at the fight — with 23.8 also taken two items down, 4 to their 6. They caught six of us out alone; we caught nobody all game. The 28.1 fight went 0-3 and the inner tower, inhibitor and Core fell between 28.2 and 28.7. When we are ahead in four lanes, the leads have to walk: shove and rotate to the fight, or nobody starts one until they do.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Minutes 19.7 to 28.7. Two 0-2 losses at 19.7 and 23.8 — both started while Mr_Meat31 and Goldilocks324 were alive and ahead in the duo lane — bracketed the window where they banked Genesis Core at 22, Fangtooth at 24 and Orb Prime at 26. The 28.1 fight was the receipt: 0-3, and our inner tower, inhibitor and Core were gone within forty seconds.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Mr_Meat31's Murdock won the carry matchup wire to wire on paper and put up 10 kills, opening on Adele at 2.5 and Rampage at 4.3. The costs came from playing it solo: six deaths, two of them caught alone (6.7 by Rampage, 20.4 by Legion), and the macro notes name him three times — 12.7, 19.7, 23.8 — as ahead and in lane while fights were lost 0-2 and 0-3. A winning lane is a rotation engine, not a farm to sit in. And Tainted Rounds landed as the fourth item, around minute 31 by the gold model in a 29-minute game, while Rampage healed 32,148 — the anti-heal needed to come slots earlier.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Goldilocks324's Phase went 3/3/11 with 18 wards and 15,065 healing, in a support lane the paper read favored all game. The same three macro notes name her alongside Murdock — ahead, alive, and absent from the 0-2 and 0-3 losses at 12.7, 19.7 and 23.8 — and she was caught alone by Rampage at 20.8 in the stretch where the game slid. By the gold model her Tainted Scepter was the last item, around minute 30 in a 29-minute game. The fix for the duo is shared: cash the lane lead into mid-map presence while it still decides fights, and move as a pair rather than getting picked crossing solo.
